motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Construction lines drawing; cover lift-off; view-transition recede.

motion.name: state

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: Drawer and search sheets slide in.

motion.name: rosette-construct
motion.value: grid 1600ms; compass and strapwork 900ms delayed by distance/260; tiles 900ms from scale 0.3, -45deg
motion.purpose: Masthead rosette builds itself on load.

motion.name: band-scroll
motion.value: scroll-linked --p over the lower 45% of the viewport
motion.purpose: Tile bands: strapwork draws, then tiles scale up and turn from -45deg.

motion.name: cover-in
motion.value: 420ms per tile, 220ms spread from tap point, 84px lattice
motion.purpose: Page change: destination glaze tiles close over the screen.

motion.name: cover-out
motion.value: 520ms per tile from top centre, scale 0 and +45deg

motion.name: parallax
motion.purpose: Masthead art drifts slower than the page.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation/transition 1ms; cover, parallax, band scroll and view transitions off
motion.purpose: Every element lands in its final state.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Girih of Registan"**

The guidebook is built the way Samarkand and Registan tilework is built: first a construction grid, then compass arcs, then the eight-point star-and-cross (khatam) tiles that fill the plane exactly. That one geometry is the whole system. It draws the masthead rosettes, the tile bands along every masthead edge, the guide character's body, the bullet of every list and table of contents, the rule in prose, and the cover that closes over the screen when you change page. The owner pinned the Hamkorbank logo and its greens on 27.10.2026, so the Registan glazes are the bank's greens: night green-black through deep, pine, teal and emerald to glowing mint, with the logo's corner light. White is the only relief colour; green-black ink carries the words.

Every chapter of the newcomer's route owns one glaze and shows it as a flat, saturated field: the masthead, the header while you are on that masthead, the sticky chapter heading, the next-step pager and the page cover all take the same field. Reading never happens on colour: under the masthead the page turns to a calm white column at 18px with a 66ch measure. Controls are cut, not rounded: every button, chip, tile, sheet and dock carries 45-degree chamfered corners. Motion explains construction (lines draw, then tiles set) and progress (rails fill, stars turn); with reduced motion everything lands in its final state.

The system rejects the category default it was chosen against: grey ground, shadowed cards, rounded icon tiles, gradient heroes. Depth comes from field against white, never from shadow.
keyCharacteristics: One geometry (8-point star-and-cross khatam) for art, markers, guide, cover and progress.
Six chapter glazes as flat fields; white reading column; green-black ink.
45-degree chamfers on every control; no rounded corners in the site's own UI.
Tektur for voice, Geologica for reading, JetBrains Mono for data.
Phone first: dock under the thumb, header that steps aside while reading, 48px taps.
Motion constructs and reports progress; reduced motion lands every element in its final state.

rules.name: The Bank Greens Rule
rules.body: The palette is the Hamkorbank ramp plus white and ink. A new colour must come from a glaze field's kit; there are no greys, blues or purples.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: A surface is either one flat glaze field or white. Fields do not mix, stripe or gradient into each other; the only light on a field is the corner light in its top-right corner.

rules.name: The Red Means Danger Rule
rules.body: Warning Red appears only where the reader must not miss something. Never as an accent, never on a field.

rules.name: The Eighteen Rule
rules.body: Reading text is 18px Geologica at 1.6 line-height, never smaller than 0.95rem for any sentence a reader must act on, and never wider than 66ch.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Tektur speaks, Geologica explains, Mono states facts. Do not set paragraphs in Tektur or headings in Mono.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Cards, tiles, doors and notes never carry shadows. If something needs to stand out, give it a field.

rules.name: The Cut Corner Rule
rules.body: If it can be pressed, it is chamfered. If it is chamfered, it can be pressed or it holds content (sheet, quote, guide bubble).

rules.name: The Final State Rule
rules.body: Under `prefers-reduced-motion` every animation and transition collapses to 1ms, the cover and parallax and band scroll-linking are off, the statement shows fully, reveals are visible, the guide stops blinking and the phone demo shows its result screen. Nothing is hidden behind motion.

dos: **Do** give every chapter-scoped element a `data-glaze` and read the field kit (`--field`, `--on-field`, `--field-ink`, `--field-soft`, tiles) instead of naming colours.
**Do** read on white: 18px Geologica, 1.6 line-height, 66ch measure, ink to ink-3 only.
**Do** chamfer every control at 45 degrees, scaling the cut from 6px (chips) to 18px (sheets).
**Do** use the eight-point star as the marker for lists, progress, current state and dividers.
**Do** keep taps at 48px or more and primary actions within thumb reach on phones.
**Do** let construction lines draw before tiles set, and let rotations land on 45 degrees.
donts: **Don't** use colours outside the Hamkorbank green ramp, white and ink; red only for warnings.
**Don't** put shadows on cards, tiles, doors or notes; stand out with a field.
**Don't** round corners in the site's own UI.
**Don't** set reading text on a glaze field or below 0.95rem.
**Don't** use mint as text on white.
**Don't** blend fields into each other with gradients; the corner light is the only light on a field.
